text:
aj: Heads-up — seeing a sustained delta between metering-ingest and enforcer counts for a handful of orgs, leading to unexpected throttles this morning. Suspect writeback/backfill timing is the issue.
maria: Which orgs and how big is the delta?
aj: org: acme-inc and some internal test keys. Delta ~15-30% token short on enforcer vs ingest over a 12h window. Query attached.
aj: ```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_ingested) as ingested, SUM(tokens_enforced) as enforced, (ingested-enforced) as delta
FROM metering_aggregates
WHERE day >= '2026-03-15' AND day <= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY org_id
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
devon: I think this is the fanout/writeback worker lag — we've had 3 restarts on metering-fanout in the last 24h (killed by OOM during a big spike). Some events never reached the aggregator, so enforcer saw fewer tokens.
eva: If that's true we should avoid hard throttles while backfill is pending. Can we increase the grace window + enable shadow enforcement for affected shards?
kevin: Agreed. Also we need a dashboard metric that shows (ingest - enforced) by org in realtime, with alert when > 10% for > 30m. Console UX is missing that signal.
sre-bot: alert: metering_delta_high fired for shard-3 at 2026-03-16T08:12:32Z (threshold=10%).
aj: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) set enforcer.grace_window=15m for impacted shards 2) flip enforcer.shadow=true for rollout 3) run incremental backfill (idempotent) from last checkpoint 4) add delta gauge & alert 5) postmortem + restart memory tuning for fanout worker.
maria: Sounds good. For backfill, ensure de-dupe keys to avoid double-counting. Need idempotent upserts on counters.
devon: Pseudocode for idempotent writeback:
```sql
-- idempotent upsert using event_id watermark
INSERT INTO usage_counters (org_id, key, tokens, last_event_id, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, now())
ON CONFLICT (org_id, key) DO UPDATE SET
  tokens = usage_counters.tokens + EXCLUDED.tokens
  WHERE EXCLUDED.last_event_id > usage_counters.last_event_id;
```
This ensures we only apply new events. Backfill job should iterate by event_id range.
eva: We should also include a safety cap on backfill apply rate to avoid sudden quota spikes (and avoid unthrottling users too quickly). Maybe 1.5x real-time for first hour.
kevin: For dashboarding: add two new series to per-route quota page: "tokens_ingested" and "tokens_enforced" with rolling-1h delta. Put a big-red warning on org page if delta > 10%. I can wire the Grafana panel.
ops: For immediate manual relief: which orgs should we toggle grace for? Provide list and owners.
aj: I'll DM the list to @ops and owners. Starting rollout to shards 2-4 now.
devon: Backfill job plan: spark job that scans metering-events, groups by org/key, writes to usage_counters via the idempotent upsert. Retry+checkpointing every 10m. Command: `spark-submit --class com.redwood.metering.Backfill --start 2026-03-15 --end 2026-03-16 --shards 2,3,4`
maria: Add a reconciliation run after backfill: compare ingested vs enforced, produce CSV and auto-open a ticket for any orgs still >5%.
kevin: I'll add the alert and dashboard panels, ETA 2 hours.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: enforcer config change applied to shard-3 (grace_window=15m, shadow=true) by aj at 2026-03-16T09:01:12Z :white_check_mark:
ops: Noted. Keep me posted if any org complains.
aj: Postmortem owners: devon (root cause + fanout memory), maria (backfill + reconciliation), kevin (dashboards + alerts), eva (rollout policy + doc). I'll follow up with a short runbook for emergency grace toggles. :thumbsup:
eva: Also let's add a long-term fix: durable fanout (checkpoint before ack) + better mem limits, and an enforcer hedging path that can fetch recent unprocessed events on demand.
devon: Filed issue #INF-783: durable-fanout-checkpointing.
kevin: Closing loop: once backfill done, we'll flip shadow=false and reduce grace_window to normal after 24h of stable delta < 2%.
aj: Thanks all — replays starting now, will report progress in here every 30m.
